memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Hypertension and gout stable.
Evidence: Blood pressure 148/92 mmHg, serum uric acid 7.8 mg/dL (target <6), serum creatinine 1.1 mg/dL. Patient reports occasional knee pain and mild headache, denies dyspnea or wheeze. Examination: lungs clear to auscultation, no edema, pulses regular. Inhaler: salbutamol metered-dose inhaler used as needed for occasional wheeze; technique checked: correct. Spirometry: FEV1 2.1 L (85% predicted), FVC 2.6 L, FEV1/FVC 0.81; change from prior not applicable. Asthma Control Test score 22 (well controlled). Smoking status: never smoker.
